evidence.quote:
now requires a signed release
manifest before it ships

observations.why: A directive that frames deployment as contingent on a gate the speaker is imposing — authority-ranking enacted through a requirement.

evidence.quote:
two unsigned artifacts reach staging
last quarter and that is the whole reason for the gate

observations.why: Justifies the gate by proportionality — past cost (unsigned artifacts) is the stated reason for the present consequence (the gate), a cost/benefit framing.
Restates the gate as a requirement — authority-ranking enacted through a mandatory condition on deployment.
Extends the gate's scope across environments — authority-ranking enacted by declaring the reach of the requirement.
Self-designation as owner of the gate — authority-ranking enacted by claiming positional responsibility for the rule.

mints.name: GateAsMandate
mints.title: a required condition imposed before something ships
mints.frame: Is the speaker here enacting authority by declaring a mandatory precondition, rather than merely describing a process?
